_doc: Hand decisions for tools/state_towns.py (re-run it after editing; never hand-edit towns.tsv). Sources: Census Gazetteer 2023 places, popest 2023 (incorporated), Gazetteer 2010 POP10 (CDPs).
_regions: First match wins. 'sky' = southeast high grassland (Sierra Vista, Bisbee, Willcox, Patagonia); 'high' = Colorado Plateau + central highlands, i.e. the Mogollon Rim and everything north/east of it (Flagstaff, Prescott, Payson, Show Low). Everything else is the low desert.
_tagLists: river = towns on the Colorado River (Lake Havasu to Yuma, plus Page at Lake Powell).
_cdp: CDPs are kept when pop2010 >= cdpMinPop, not excluded, without a hyphen and without a drop word; keepCdp overrides all of that.
_rename: Census 'Village of Oak Creek (Big Park)' is signed and known as Village of Oak Creek.
_excludeCdp: Subdivision/trailer-park style CDP names, generic words, and CDPs named after a bigger city (Goodyear Village, Maricopa Colony).
_keepCdp: Well-known places the drop-word/hyphen filter would remove.
